topic: Independent fresh re-check of the rendered anonymous-cart shipping quotes for all three tracked Crema e Gusto vendors
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 through scripts/browser-research.mjs (npm run research:browser), one live session kept across steps. One temporary anonymous cart per vendor was built by adding the tracked product on the real product page; the public cart/checkout estimator was then read. No order, payment, login, account creation or street address was submitted; no bot challenge or access control was bypassed. For Pucks only the locality (תל אביב) and postcode (6100000) fields were filled, because that estimator applies the fee to the summary only after a delivery method is chosen; all other personal fields were left empty. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded; the checkout URL query strings that contain a cart id/session id are not reproduced here (public entry URL recorded instead).
toolingLimitation: The available file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the four screenshots could not be machine-inspected by the model. Every amount below is backed by the rendered visible text captured through the same live session; the screenshots are kept as artifacts for a human reviewer. No claim of image-based visual review is made.

quotes.service: משלוח עד הבית (home delivery), the only offered method
quotes.qualification: The fee appears in the delivery-methods card as 'משלוח עד הבית 30 ₪' together with 'משלוח חינם בהזמנה מעל 100 ₪'; the summary total includes it (90 ₪) only after the delivery card is selected. Before selection the same page prints 'המשלוח מחושב בתשלום' and a 60 ₪ total, so the rate is conditional on the chosen method, not automatic.

relationshipToEarlierEvidence: This re-check reproduces the amounts recorded in 2026-10-12-vendor-shipping-quotes.json (Pucks 1/2/4 packs, CoffeeMan 8-pack, Coffee4U methods) and in 2026-10-12-pucks-recheck.json. It is a fresh observation of the same public flows, not a new rate; the earlier files remain the fuller matrix (Pucks 1-pack and Eilat, CoffeeMan distribution/pickup detail, Coffee4U 421-city pickup list).
